Before awakening, the player undergoes a 3-minute &6"Harvest Festival"&r:
During the first minute, the player cannot use any skills and has restricted vision and movement. All followers in range automatically switch to "Follow and Protect".

quest.0E4E2A348018B02E.quest_desc: &8In ancient times, two races ruled the overworld.

&8One day, a war broke out between the two, and the war soon came to an end. In order to eradicate the roots, the victor sent powerful mages to tear apart the space, created a replica of the main world, imprisoned the defeated party in it, and imposed various curses...

&8Because of the curse, the time of this Dimension is forever locked at dusk, stars are dying, and ether liquid falls from the sky; perhaps the disaster inspired people's desire for survival, or perhaps the punishment promoted people's hatred. Instead of dying, the exiled people established their own civilization. They called themselves "Starlight People" and focused on developing magic, hoping to make a comeback one day...

&8In the end, the giant fell, but the damage caused could not be reversed; the Starlight people made a desperate move and tried to use ancient magic to open the portal to the main world; they seemed to succeed, a dark door glowing with purple light opened, and before there was any time to think, the survivors swarmed in...
&8Some plants are affected by magic and take on magical elements, becoming very different from their ancestors.&r

quest.0FDA8DE439A0FC25.quest_desc: &4To disable this system, use the following gamerule:

[Soul Energy] is randomly generated upon your first reincarnation, ranging from 500,000 to 7,000,000.
Your initial Soul Energy is always sufficient to obtain your first Unique Skill.
After that, Reset Scrolls and other scrolls do not reroll your Soul Energy.
Resetting your character restores your current Soul Energy to your Soul Energy maximum.
The Soul Energy maximum can only be permanently increased through specific actions.
Obtaining a new Unique Skill consumes Soul Energy according to the strength of that skill.
You cannot obtain the Unique Skill if you do not have enough Soul Energy.
Initial Soul Energy probabilities:
&6Triggering an awakening event increases Soul Energy by 500,000–1,000,000.
&6An awakening event can be triggered again after each reset.
&6Completing a Reset Counter quest increases Soul Energy by 500,000–1,000,000.
&6Receiving a name can permanently increase Soul Energy.
&6Naming yourself can grant up to 250,000 Soul Energy.
&6If another player names you, the amount gained depends on how much more Soul Energy they have than you, up to a maximum gain of 1,000,000.
&6If the naming player has Soul Energy less than or equal to yours, you may gain no Soul Energy.
&6The Soul Energy increase from naming can only occur once and cannot be triggered again, even after a reset.
Command to check Soul Energy:
/mysticism get stat AblazeAQZL soulEnergy current

&6&lInside the Labyrinth:&r

-One of the strongest spirit types.

-Required to awaken as a Hero (collect all 6 types).
-Use [Summon Greater Elemental] to materialize your greater spirits (switch modes as needed).
&44. Spirit King (Grade 4)&r
-Currently the strongest spirit type.

quest.4DB740093C0BA804.quest_desc: Each artifact has a Grade, an equipment slot, an EP threshold, and one or more effects. Once an artifact reaches the required EP, the effect attached to that EP threshold becomes active. Higher-Grade artifacts are more concise and generally unlock fewer effects. Grade 1 artifacts have the most progression, with up to three effects available to unlock.
Artifact Grades and Progression
Artifacts are divided into three Grades. Each Grade determines the artifact's starting EP, effect unlock requirements, and refinement limit.
&6Grade 3 Artifacts
- Start at 52,000 EP
- Unlock their effect at 52,000 EP
- Can reach up to 10 refinements
&6Grade 2 Artifacts
- Start at 52,000 EP
- Unlock their first effect at 52,000 EP
- Unlock their second effect at 225,000 EP
- Can reach up to 5 refinements
&6Grade 1 Artifacts
- Start at 225,000 EP
- Unlock their first effect at 225,000 EP
- Unlock their second effect at 1,000,000 EP
- Unlock their third effect at 5,000,000 EP
- Some final effects also require the correct Unique Skill or condition
- Can reach up to 3 refinements
{@pagebreak}
Artifacts are upgraded in an anvil by combining two identical artifacts.
The primary artifact must first be evolved far enough to qualify for the upgrade.
&6- Grade 3 artifacts can be upgraded after reaching 52,000 EP
&6- Grade 2 artifacts can be refined after reaching 225,000 EP
&6- Grade 1 artifacts can be refined after reaching 5,000,000 EP
Refinement increases the strength of artifact effects. Under the current system, each refinement upgrade is randomly assigned to one valid effect.
Some effects have their own refinement caps. Once an effect reaches its cap, subsequent refinements are assigned to other valid effects.

quest.565894017692BCC7.quest_desc: Resistances are divided into different levels based on acquisition difficulty: Easy / Medium / Hard. Each difficulty has different requirements.
&lEasy:&r Taking more than 5 damage in a single hit grants 1 Learning Point. Requires 350 points to fully learn.
&lMedium:&r Taking more than 15 damage in a single hit grants 1 Learning Point. Requires 500 points to fully learn.
&lHard:&r Taking more than 20 damage in a single hit grants 1 Learning Point. Requires 700 points to fully learn.
The default difficulty of each resistance is as follows:
&lMedium:&r Pain, Pierce, Natural Attacks, and Holy Attacks. Natural Attacks include the 7 major elements, Gravity, Lightning, Heat, and Cold.
&lHard:&r Physical Attacks, Magic, Spiritual Attacks, and Abnormal Status.
Resistances can also be learned from damage below the damage threshold.
Damage below the threshold accumulates. When the accumulated value reaches 10 times the threshold damage, 1 Learning Point is gained.
For example, Physical Attack Resistance requires taking more than 20 damage in a single hit to gain 1 Learning Point.

If the player takes less than 20 damage, such as 12 damage, the skill does not immediately gain a Learning Point. Instead, it gains 12 "Damage Points". When these points accumulate to 200, which is 20 x 10, the skill gains 1 Learning Point.
Whenever the skill gains 1 Learning Point, its "Damage Points" reset to 0.
What should we do if a creature has resistance?

For the most troublesome example, Physical Resistance, the solution is simple: switch to elemental or magical damage. Physical Resistance only blocks physical damage, so Fire skills and magic attacks are completely unaffected.

quest.5CAB6913DE075CEB.quest_desc: Open the door with the Master Clock Key

&8It was once the core mechanism of Temporal Dawn, the center toward which all clock towers, vaults, and portals pointed. The clockmakers believed that as long as they controlled the Master Clock, they could make time obey their will: reverse wounds, instantly mature crops, and return a city to yesterday before disaster struck.

&8They built the Master Clock in the deepest part of the dimension, supporting its operation with countless gears, Clockstone, and Time Crystals. Every corridor was engraved with precise time formulas, and behind every door was a mechanism used to stabilize the world. Back then, the Master Clock was not a prison, but a temple dedicated to time.
&8When the Master Clock struck its thirteenth chime, time throughout the entire dungeon stopped.
&8Patrolling guards froze mid-step, burning flames solidified in the air, and the shadows of the clockmakers were pinned to the walls. Only the Master Clock kept turning, faster and faster.
&8No one knows where the Time Tyrant truly came from.
&8Some say it was the will born from the Master Clock itself.
&8Some say it was a monster formed from countless failed experiments, dead clockmakers, and shattered time.
&8Others say it was simply time's retaliation against human arrogance.

&8Since then, the Master Clock Dungeon has been completely sealed. The entrance responds only to the Master Clock Key, and the walls are protected by the Time Tyrant's power, making them impossible to break with ordinary tools. Anyone who tries to enter the core hall will hear a deep chime from far away, as if counting down to their own end.
&8But the Master Clock still has not stopped.
&8With every turn, Temporal Dawn remains frozen.
&8The forests no longer truly grow, the waves no longer truly advance, and day and night have been torn into chaotic fragments. The entire dimension is trapped in the same dawn that can never end.

After clicking to enter the interface, you can see the evolution goal on the right side and the conditions for evolution on the lower right side.&lIf there are many evolution conditions, remember to scroll down with your mouse wheel to check. Don’t miss any information.
{image:ablazeaqzlcz:textures/ftb/personal_panel_3.png width:80 height:80 align:center}
The current conditions are divided into the following categories:
1. Obtain Existence Points (EP)
&6EP is obtained by killing monsters. Under normal circumstances, 3% of the EP value of the killed monster is obtained.
&r
2. Consume [item]
&6You need to right-click the item to eat it (most of it). If it cannot be eaten, you usually need to use the Absorb & Dissolve Skill to hold the corresponding item and press the Skill key.&r
3. Kill the leader/Boss
&6Can be any Boss&4But not repeatable&6
{@pagebreak}
4. Obtain a Spirit
&6Travel to the Labyrinth Tree and obtain any elemental Spirit.&r
5. Become [True Demon Lord/True Hero]
&5True Demon Lord evolution requirements
&r0. Be a Majin or Chaos being, and possess a Demon Lord Seed.
1. Obtain 10,000 Souls (2,000 EP = 1 Soul). Souls can be gained by killing creatures after reaching 200,000 EP, which also automatically grants a Demon Lord Seed.
2. And click the Awakening button on the left side of the race interface
3. Only effective for Demon Lord Seed
If the evolution button is not displayed after meeting the conditions, you can enter the command to evolve: /evolve demonlord
&6True Hero Evolution Requirements
&r0. Be a Living or Chaos being.
1. Contract with 6 Greater Spirits to develop a Hero Egg.

2. With a Hero Egg and at least 400,000 EP, fight Hinata or Charybdis while at 20% health to become a True Hero. Alternatively, use a Hero Scroll redeemed through the Main Story quests (a Hero Egg is still required).
6. Proficient [Skill]
&6You need to acquire and use this Skill until you become proficient.&r(This goal is rare)
7. Have a name
&61. Press Shift+N to turn on Soul Eater naming (True)&r
&62. Kill 1,000 Humans (Witches, Villagers, Pillagers, or Otherworlders), or complete 25 Pillager Raids.
&64. The soul will be automatically named after the conditions are met.
&6Note: Turning off naming will not make the number of kills disappear, only deaths will.
